items.q: Where and when do I collect my race pack?
items.a:
Round 1: Friday 20 Nov, 12:00–20:00, Mueang Nan Provincial Police Station
Round 2: Saturday 21 Nov, 04:30–05:30, Mae Charim District Office

items.q: What do I need to bring?
items.a:
Your original ID card
Runners from the BIB promotion who exchanged a Nga Chang Dam BIB: show your BLACK IVORY TRAIL THAILAND BIB together with your original ID card to collect your shirt

items.a: Yes. Bring a copy of the runner's ID card, signed and certified as a true copy
